Imagine you're on a hot day, and you're sweating. As you sweat, you're losing water through evaporation. This water vapor rises into the air, cools, and condenses into tiny droplets. These droplets form clouds, which eventually become heavy enough to fall back to the Earth as precipitation, such as rain or snow.
